continuationStates.name: Canonical session and score continuation
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Selects one future score and advances only with an accepted prepared phrase; owns no PCM.

continuationStates.name: Voice and mix render continuation
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Carries deterministic voice, mix, tail, and output-transition memory used to render future PCM.

continuationStates.name: Generated DSP graph continuation
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Carries the one effect graph and its node memory while processing future PCM.

continuationStates.name: Accepted quality-policy continuation
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Binds accepted evidence and policy provenance without retaining PCM.

continuationStates.name: Accepted live master-headroom continuation
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Controls only a qualified future render and advances atomically with that PCM.

continuationStates.name: Rejected-candidate recovery continuation
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Coordinates bounded detached retries while rejected PCM remains uncommitted.

continuationStates.name: Long-horizon realized-signal continuation
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Retains reduced accepted evidence and may change only an eligible future score/render.

continuationStates.name: Qualified repeat-hold presentation state
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Selects exact accepted PCM or a prequalified pattern family without advancing canonical score state.

continuationStates.name: Detached preparation identity
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Binds route, policy, recovery, and proposal lookup identity before future PCM can enter a host queue.

continuationStates.name: Exact detached preparation replay identity
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Serializes exact seed, canonical session, render, graph, long-horizon, route, recovery, proposal, and future-sample identities before preparation; it retains no PCM.

continuationStates.name: Preallocated macOS PCM packet handoff
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Copies bounded app-owned scheduled-output PCM for one background consumer.

continuationStates.name: Scheduled occurrence ledger
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Authenticates copied sample ranges against exact scheduled immutable PCM occurrences.

continuationStates.name: Live-feedback lifecycle and correction state
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Authorizes at most one future correction and never rewrites current PCM.

continuationStates.name: Live PCM capture lifecycle
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Owns bounded producer/consumer lifecycle identity around the PCM queue.

continuationStates.name: Accepted PCM hold provenance
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Keeps already qualified PCM eligible when an authorized correction cannot commit.

continuationStates.name: macOS successor preparation progress
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Records bounded successor failure/repeat progress without treating rejected PCM as accepted.

continuationStates.name: Downstream monitoring gain state
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Changes only downstream device-output gain after canonical capture and evidence.

continuationStates.name: Windows route-recovery input snapshot
continuationStates.pcmRelationship: Preserves incoming canonical state so the interrupted phrase can be rerendered for the recovered route.

transitions.name: Resolve score-owned performance grammar
transitions.artifact: resolved phrase context and bars
transitions.failureBehavior: Reject an inconsistent plan before rendering.

transitions.name: Resolve instrument, pitch, and role policy
transitions.artifact: score-owned composition and role relations
transitions.failureBehavior: Preserve the canonical plan or reject malformed score relations.

transitions.name: Bind the current material world
transitions.artifact: instrument, pitch, articulation, and material-world intent
transitions.failureBehavior: Use the bounded score-owned fallback without adding another engine.

transitions.name: Create one versioned preparation transaction
transitions.artifact: AutonomousPhrasePlan and exact replay-bound PhrasePreparationRequest
transitions.failureBehavior: Fail closed on discontinuous root, phrase, bar, route, or policy identity.

transitions.name: Render score-owned voices and role taps
transitions.artifact: RenderBlock voice PCM and role-local evidence
transitions.failureBehavior: Return a reason-coded preparation failure; no PCM becomes schedulable.

transitions.name: Process the canonical graph and mix
transitions.artifact: processed stereo blocks, role taps, and ending render/graph state
transitions.failureBehavior: Reject invalid routing or use the declared protected neutral path.

transitions.name: Qualify the complete prepared candidate
transitions.artifact: candidate vector, verdict, and atomic commit provenance
transitions.failureBehavior: Reject or report qualification unavailable; never weaken a hard gate.

transitions.name: Package one immutable prepared performance phrase
transitions.artifact: PreparedPerformancePhrase with immutable qualified PCM
transitions.failureBehavior: Return no commit-eligible product when any identity or evidence binding fails.

transitions.name: Commit the prepared phrase on macOS
transitions.artifact: accepted PreparedPerformancePhrase and advanced canonical state
transitions.failureBehavior: Discard stale or unqualified work and preserve accepted PCM/fallback state.

transitions.name: Commit the prepared phrase on Windows
transitions.artifact: accepted PreparedPerformancePhrase and advanced canonical state
transitions.failureBehavior: Discard stale or unqualified work and keep the last accepted host state.

transitions.name: Schedule immutable PCM and publish bounded capture packets
transitions.artifact: sample-time scheduled buffer and authenticated capture range
transitions.failureBehavior: Do not schedule stale ranges; retain qualified fallback or report unavailable.

transitions.name: Consume app-owned scheduled-output PCM packets
transitions.artifact: sequence- and generation-bound native-stereo packets
transitions.failureBehavior: Drop invalid/full packets and continue output without blocking.

transitions.name: Convert and queue immutable PCM for waveOut
transitions.artifact: bounded Int16 waveOut buffer and scheduled visual
transitions.failureBehavior: Stop queue advancement and request recovery without callback-side work.

transitions.name: Analyze one authenticated live PCM window
transitions.artifact: bounded live-output evidence
transitions.failureBehavior: Reject incomplete, stale, late, mismatched, or unavailable windows.

transitions.name: Reduce live evidence to one future proposal
transitions.artifact: reason-coded headroom proposal and target boundary
transitions.failureBehavior: Hold or reject the proposal; current and scheduled PCM remain immutable.

transitions.name: Bind an authorized proposal to one future candidate
transitions.artifact: pending live-master binding for an unscheduled phrase
transitions.failureBehavior: Expire stale/late proposals and retain the previous committed controller state.

transitions.name: Accumulate committed semantic history
transitions.artifact: committed semantic trajectory and episode state
transitions.failureBehavior: Mark discontinuous evidence unavailable without partial advancement.

transitions.name: Render the selected long-horizon consequence
transitions.artifact: score-owned material-world render intent
transitions.failureBehavior: Use the bounded canonical score path.

transitions.name: Reduce accepted render evidence
transitions.artifact: semantic, signal, and effect-dose trajectory observation
transitions.failureBehavior: Preserve prior adaptation state when evidence is incomplete or discontinuous.

transitions.name: Apply one eligible future trajectory decision
transitions.artifact: preserve, recover, or material-reframe intent
transitions.failureBehavior: Preserve course when the decision is invalid, stale, early, or ineligible.

transitions.name: Rebuild the interrupted macOS phrase for a recovered route
transitions.artifact: route-recovery PhrasePreparationRequest
transitions.failureBehavior: Preserve the recovery request/hold and report unavailable for an unsupported route.

transitions.name: Rebuild the interrupted Windows phrase for a recovered device
transitions.artifact: route-recovery PhrasePreparationRequest
transitions.failureBehavior: Retain the recovery snapshot and do not queue mismatched PCM.

transitions.name: Present a bounded qualified macOS hold
transitions.artifact: exact accepted PCM or prequalified repeat-hold pattern family
transitions.failureBehavior: Fall back to exact accepted PCM and keep retries bounded.

transitions.name: Present a bounded qualified Windows hold
transitions.artifact: exact accepted PCM or prequalified repeat-hold pattern family
transitions.failureBehavior: Fall back to exact accepted PCM and request the successor serially.

transitions.name: Apply downstream monitoring gain
transitions.artifact: main-output-mixer gain intent
transitions.failureBehavior: Normalize invalid gain to the bounded monitoring state without changing evidence.

flows.name: macOS phrase preparation and atomic commit

flows.name: Windows phrase preparation and atomic commit
flows.summary: The Windows host consumes the same semantic plan, detached renderer, evaluator, immutable PCM, and continuation bundle before its serial state queue may accept the phrase.

flows.name: macOS scheduled playback and observation
flows.summary: macOS schedules accepted immutable PCM and the capture mixer copies only bounded app-owned samples into the authenticated background evidence path.

flows.name: Windows scheduled playback
flows.summary: Windows accepts the same immutable prepared phrase, then converts and queues bounded device PCM off the fixed-work completion callback.

steps.artifact: queued waveOut PCM and scheduled visual

flows.name: Live PCM feedback and future correction
flows.summary: Authenticated scheduled-output PCM is analyzed off-callback and may authorize one bounded proposal that becomes durable only through a later unscheduled preparation commit.

steps.artifact: committed corrected successor or accepted-PCM hold

flows.name: Long-horizon semantic and signal adaptation
flows.summary: Committed semantic history and realized signal evidence meet in one calibrated policy whose qualified result can affect only an eligible unscheduled future phrase.

boundaries.name: Detached preparation
boundaries.executionContext: Bounded cancellable non-realtime task before an unscheduled phrase boundary.
boundaries.allowedWork: Planning, rendering, analysis, candidate evaluation, deterministic correction, and immutable waveform derivation.
boundaries.forbiddenWork: Mutation of scheduled/current PCM, unbounded search, UI work, or direct audio-callback work.
boundaries.failureBehavior: Return a reason-coded unavailable/rejected outcome; stale or cancelled work cannot commit.

boundaries.name: macOS realtime production
boundaries.executionContext: AVAudioSourceNode render callback with one queue producer.
boundaries.allowedWork: Bounded fixed-capacity native-stereo copy plus lock-free index/counter updates.
boundaries.forbiddenWork: Allocation, locks, waits, analysis, logging, file/network I/O, UI, or musical decisions.
boundaries.failureBehavior: Drop the packet, increment a fixed counter, and continue audio without blocking.

boundaries.name: Background live analysis
boundaries.executionContext: Single bounded background consumer/worker outside the audio callback and MainActor.
boundaries.allowedWork: Assemble authenticated windows, analyze owned PCM, derive evidence, and propose one eligible future correction.
boundaries.forbiddenWork: Microphone/system capture, current-buffer mutation, unbounded memory/work, UI mutation, or direct commit.
boundaries.failureBehavior: Reject incomplete, stale, mismatched, late, or unavailable evidence and preserve the deterministic hold/fallback state.

boundaries.name: macOS future phrase commit
boundaries.executionContext: MainActor boundary before an unscheduled prepared phrase becomes current on macOS.
boundaries.allowedWork: Validate exact keys/generations and atomically commit plan, render, graph, quality, live-master, long-horizon, and hold state.
boundaries.forbiddenWork: Partial state commit, rejected-attempt leakage, scheduled-buffer rewrite, or stale route/session acceptance.
boundaries.failureBehavior: Discard stale/unqualified work; preserve accepted PCM or follow the declared deterministic fallback.

boundaries.name: Windows future phrase commit
boundaries.executionContext: Serial Windows host-state boundary before an unscheduled prepared phrase becomes current.
boundaries.allowedWork: Validate exact key, route generation, prepared provenance, and atomically advance the shared canonical continuation bundle.
boundaries.forbiddenWork: Partial state commit, rejected-attempt leakage, callback-side commit, or stale device/session acceptance.
boundaries.failureBehavior: Discard stale/unqualified work and retain the last accepted host state or unavailable status.

boundaries.name: macOS sample-time scheduling
boundaries.executionContext: MainActor transport control before immutable AVAudioPCMBuffer scheduling.
boundaries.allowedWork: Select an accepted block or qualified hold family, bind its scheduled sample range, and queue immutable PCM.
boundaries.forbiddenWork: Rendering, evaluation, scheduled-buffer mutation, unbounded retry, or audio-callback analysis.
boundaries.failureBehavior: Keep already accepted PCM eligible, open bounded successor recovery, or report unavailable.

boundaries.name: Windows control-thread scheduling
boundaries.executionContext: Serial Windows host queue outside the waveOut completion callback.
boundaries.allowedWork: Select qualified immutable PCM, convert it to bounded Int16 buffers, queue waveOut, and update read-only visuals.
boundaries.forbiddenWork: Callback-side conversion/submission, unqualified PCM, partial canonical commit, or musical planning.
boundaries.failureBehavior: Stop queue advancement, retain accepted state, and request bounded device recovery.

boundaries.name: macOS route recovery
boundaries.executionContext: MainActor route-change lifecycle followed by detached rerendering for the active route.
boundaries.allowedWork: Invalidate stale work, preserve the interrupted phrase's incoming bundle/hold, and request one route-bound rerender.
boundaries.forbiddenWork: Reuse wrong-rate PCM, double-advance continuation, clear a latched hold, or perform planning in the callback.
boundaries.failureBehavior: Keep the recovery request and accepted hold provenance or report the route unavailable.

boundaries.name: Windows device recovery
boundaries.executionContext: Serial Windows host-state recovery after waveOut device restart.
boundaries.allowedWork: Preserve the interrupted incoming bundle and rerender one route-generation-bound phrase before queueing resumes.
boundaries.forbiddenWork: Queue stale-rate PCM, advance twice, mutate canonical state in the completion callback, or bypass primary qualification.
boundaries.failureBehavior: Retain the recovery snapshot and remain recovering/unavailable until a valid device-bound phrase is prepared.

boundaries.name: MainActor presentation
boundaries.executionContext: SwiftUI/AppKit MainActor presentation and bounded user transport actions.
boundaries.allowedWork: Render status, waveform, time, inspector data, and dispatch play/pause or New Set intent.
boundaries.forbiddenWork: Musical planning, DSP analysis, PCM mutation, callback work, or technical parameter control.
boundaries.failureBehavior: Show coherent preparing/recovering/unavailable state without inventing runtime success.

boundaries.name: Windows waveOut completion callback
boundaries.allowedWork: Only fixed atomic completion and played-frame counter updates.
boundaries.forbiddenWork: Allocation, PCM conversion, cleanup, queue submission, preparation, scheduling, logging, or UI work.
boundaries.failureBehavior: Record fixed completion state; non-callback control work performs cleanup or recovery.
